messages:
sara: Quick follow-up to the pinning schema RFC. Proposal: add a "compatibility-hash binding" that groups tiny variant diffs under a stable compatibility id for a short TTL so routers/telemetry treat them as one logical surface while still recording exact variant hashes in audit logs.

mike: ok interesting. main concern is silent semantic drift. how are we proving compatibility? single eval number seems brittle.

yun: agree. onboarding should emit an evidence bundle (eval_id + delta_metrics) and platform should run a cheap verification against a canonical smoke test. only then grant the compat_hash.

kevin: schema sketch (optional fields in rollout metadata): compat_hash: string, compat_ttl_days: int, compat_mode: enum("strict","relaxed"), compat_evidence_id: string, compat_score: float, compat_pools: [string]. Router resolves compat_hash -> variant set deterministically.

sara: important: compat_hash is not authoritative for audit. audit lines must still include variant_hash, runtime_pool, and resolved_compat_hash if used. UI/telemetry shows both per-variant and grouped metrics.

lucas: tenant pin precedence: absolutely. If tenant pins to a variant, that mapping wins. Add tenant_settings.allow_compat_binding: bool default true but false for regulated tenants.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for variant v3-quant on release/2026-04-01 :rocket:

mike: deprecation lifecycle: phases = grouped (soft), notice (notify owners + tenants, suggested_migration), retire (hard). Need deprecation_phase enum + deprecation_eta timestamp.

yun: autoscaler note: compat groups mixing differing pool affinities (e.g., int8 vs fp16) can break capacity planning. enforce compat_pools and require pool_fallback_policy field: enum("prefer","mirror","reject").

kevin: implementation detail: compute compat_hash deterministically so replicas and backfills agree: compat_hash = sha256(owner_id + sorted(variant_hashes)). Store canonical member list with timestamp when group formed.

sara: we also need a revocation path: if a later variant in the group regresses beyond a threshold, platform should emit a revocation event and optionally auto-split the group. Add revocation_reason and revocation_ts fields.

lucas: UX: surface "Suggested migration" banner to tenants when group forms with clear CTA and show migration metrics (expected latency delta, cost delta). Offer one-click opt-in to migrate.

mike: telemetry/metrics collection: migration_success_rate, post-group regression_count, latency_delta_p95, cost_delta_per_token, and false_positive_count when a group later revoked.

yun: compliance: provide exportable audit report per tenant that lists exact variant hashes used across a timeframe even if compat_hash was applied.

sara: next steps: i'll open a small RFC + data-model PR with the fields: compat_hash, compat_ttl_days, compat_mode, compat_evidence_id, compat_score, compat_pools, pool_fallback_policy, deprecation_phase, deprecation_eta, revocation_reason, revocation_ts, tenant_settings.allow_compat_binding, suggested_migration. will include deterministic id algo and sample logs.

kevin: please include a short playbook for rollback and thresholds for auto-revocation. Also list which telemetry we need retained for 90/365 day audits.

sara: will do. aiming to post RFC draft link later today. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
